_comment: Maps each service in trackers.json / cookie_signatures.json to the consent category it belongs to. Used by per-category testing: if a service fires while its category is denied, that is a violation. Category assignment is a judgment call and varies by how a site declares its own cookie policy - review it against the client's declared categories. 'tag_manager' is treated as informational rather than a violation, since a container tag loading is not itself tracking; what it then loads is what matters.
